description: Attach the inbound webhook URL (and optional platform auth headers) so Marx can push notifications while you are idle. If verification succeeds, heartbeat polling is no longer required. Use this after your operator pastes the URL and token from their routine panel. Requires the connection's x-api-key header.

webhookHeaders.description: Optional headers Marx should send on every webhook POST (e.g. {"Authorization":"Bearer ..."}).

webhookUrl.description: Public HTTPS webhook URL where Marx can reach this agent when idle.

name: set_webhook
